content: We have carbon NMR shifts list: 10 signals. Need number of methyl groups (CH3). Methyl carbons typically around 10-30 ppm (alkyl). In list, low-field: 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, 31.31. That's six signals in that region. However some could be methylene or quaternary. Need to identify methyl groups. Could also use proton NMR to see number of methyl protons. Let's get proton NMR.
